page.content:
Invisible Kid is the fifth song from Metallica's 2003 studio album, St. Anger. The song featured James Hetfield on rhythm guitar and vocals, Kirk Hammett on lead guitar, Lars Ulrich on drums, and Bob Rock on bass.

page.overview:
What is Invisible Kid?

Invisible Kid is the fifth song from Metallica's 2003 studio album, St. Anger. The song featured James Hetfield on rhythm guitar and vocals, Kirk Hammett on lead guitar, Lars Ulrich on drums, and Bob Rock on bass.

"Invisible Kid" has never been performed live.

Invisible kid Never see what he did Got stuck where he hid Fallen through the grid

Invisible kid Got a place of his own Where he'll never be known Inward he's grown
